Seeds 87 for preparation and 88/188/288 for sample phases; Tsim continues its native prepared stream.
The initial probes borrowed d5 metadata while overriding the artifact; template_workload preserves that original label. Actual artifact hashes and semantic masks are recorded here.
logical_errors is the legacy field name for raw observable-0 ones; no decoded logical-error estimate.
